get.description:
Gets all accounts that match the given criteria. 

Five filter query parameters can be sent and they work with an 'AND' relationship:
 1. Account name
 2. Member email
 3. Domain name
 4. Sfdc Account Id
 5. Review Status
 
The following query parameters are optional and can be used to control the sorting and pagination of the results:
 - Sort Field
 - Sort Direction
 - Page Number
 - Page Size

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This parameter will search for an account that has the given name.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: This parameter will search for all accounts that contain a given member email.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description:
This parameter will search for all accounts that contain at least one member email with the given domain name.

 Domain examples: safebase.io, example.com

parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

Approve access request

 Takes as input an object that must have one of two keys (not both):

 

1. accountId - The account ID under which to approve the request 

2. account - Account information. The account will be created and the request will be approved under it 

**Idempotent Operation**: If the request has already been approved or declined, this endpoint will return a 409 Conflict response instead of an error. This allows for safe retries without side effects.
